species: Real close-up recording of a Roman snail (Helix pomatia) eating a lettuce leaf: the faint rasping scrapes of its radula (its rough, file-like tongue)
note: Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording, made about 10 cm from the snail. The 1 kHz high-pass removes the measured kitchen background rumble, which sits below the rasps.
